item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nactual=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nassert actual==report,(actual,report)\\nassert set(report[0])=={'ok','records','errors'}\\nassert set(report[0]['records'][0])=={'id','amount'}\\nprint(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nprobes=[\\n({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':2},'unique':True}),\\n({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':True,'unit':[]},{'id':'x','amount':1,'unit':[]},{'id':'x','amount':1},{'id':'x','amount':2}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':1},'unique':True}),\\n({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'z','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'q','amount':-0.0}]},{'base_unit':'u','units':{'u':3},'unique':False})]\\nfor request,policy in probes:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(policy)\\n result=evaluate(request,policy)\\n assert request==rb and policy==pb\\n print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}}]}"}
